topic: Science Process Skills: Observing, Predicting, Measuring
key_concepts: Observing uses the senses to gather information about objects and events.
Observing is the most basic science process skill and is needed for more complex skills.
Tools such as hand lenses, rulers, and metersticks extend the senses and make observations
Predicting is a science process skill based on careful observations and patterns.

Rulers and metersticks are used to measure length, width, and height.
Science process skills include observing, predicting, and measuring.
Scientists use science process skills when performing simple science activities.
